quote.quote: concluded that an advisory committee meeting was not warranted as the safety profile of DMF is acceptable for the treatment of patients with relapsing forms of MS

no_adcom_quote.quote: the Division took great care to consider the arguments it advanced and, in view of the totality of the data including the clinical safety database included in the NDA that did not identify any significant renal toxicity in humans, concluded that an advisory committee meeting was not warranted as the safety profile of DMF is acceptable for the treatment of patients with relapsing forms of MS. This decision was discussed with and supported by senior management.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for TECFIDERA (dimethyl fumarate, NDA204063). Both the Summary Review (Section 9, 'N/A') and the Medical Review (Section 9.2, 'Not applicable') state no AC meeting was held. The Office Director's summary review notes the need for an AC was carefully considered — including in response to a Citizen's Petition citing the nonclinical renal/cancer findings and calling for AC review of MS drug applications — but the Division concluded, with senior management support, that an advisory committee meeting was not warranted because the clinical safety database identified no significant human renal toxicity and the safety profile was acceptable.
